## SD PROMPT STRATEGY
[Engine will populate this after first analysis pass]

Current baseline (from prompt guide):
- Layer structure: Subject → Environment → Style → Mood/Lighting → Detail
- Style anchor is non-negotiable: fine ink etching, 17th century engraving,
  aged parchment, esoteric illustration, masterwork
- Core negative terms: modern, photorealistic, 3d, CGI, plastic, blurry,
  watermark, human figure, face, vibrant colors, neon
- Keep prompt to 8-12 strong modifiers; overloading degrades CPU output
- Subject always first; style anchor always present; quality terms last
